resources.string: Accessibility permission: kya aur kyun
Doomscroll Duel ko reels gin-ne ke liye Android ki Accessibility service chahiye. Permission dene se pehle ye zaroor padho.
Ye service kya karti hai
Instagram, YouTube (Shorts), Facebook aur Snapchat mein tum kitni reels ya short videos swipe karte ho, wo gintati hai.
Sirf jab tum khud Strict Lock, Bedtime, Focus hours ya Wait-10 chalu karo: in 4 apps mein reels khulne par Back ya Home dabakar reels band karti hai aur \"Brain bachao\" screen dikhati hai.
Iske liye ye sirf ye dekhti hai: kaunsa app khula hai (in 4 mein se), scroll hua ya nahi, aur reels wali screen khuli hai ya nahi. Screen ka text padhe bina.
Ye kya NAHI karti
Tumhare messages (chat, DM), passwords, OTP ya payment details nahi padhti.
Ye nahi padhti ki tum kaunsi video ya post dekh rahe ho, kisi ka naam, caption ya comment.
In 4 ke alawa koi aur app nahi dekhti. Screen record ya screenshot nahi leti, aur tumhare badle tap ya typing nahi karti.
Tumhara data
Sirf reels ki ginti save hoti hai: roz ki total aur app-wise. Ye ginti tumhare phone pe rehti hai. Duel khelne par yehi ginti tumhare duel ke dost ko dikhai jaati hai.
Hum ye data kisi ko becha ya share nahi karte, aur ads ke liye use nahi karte.
Tum kabhi bhi Android Settings mein Accessibility mein jaakar ise band kar sakte ho. Account delete karne par server se tumhara data hat jata hai.
In English

Doomscroll Duel uses Android\'s Accessibility service to count short videos (Reels, Shorts, Spotlight) in Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat and, only when you turn on a lock, to block them by pressing Back or Home. It sees only which of these four apps is open, that a scroll happened, and whether a reels screen is showing. It does not read your messages, passwords, or what you watch. Only your daily reel count is stored; it is not sold, not shared with advertisers and not used for ads. You can switch the service off at any time in Android Settings.
AGREE
NOT NOW
Not now dabane par reel counter band rahega. Baaki app chalta rahega, aur tum baad mein ise chalu kar sakte ho.
